visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit retail environment, focusing on a display shelf filled with numerous white Maneki-neko (beckoning cat) figurines of various sizes. The cats feature traditional red and gold decorations. (2) A hand with a white sleeve holds a small red Daruma doll wrapped in clear plastic. In the background, similar red charms are stacked on shelves. (3) The camera pans across a variety of unique items: a calico cat statue wearing a red bib and small, colorful tanuki figures in branded boxes. (4) A hand reaches into a basket filled with conical red "Sankaku Daruma" dolls, accompanied by explanatory cards. The setting is a clean, organized department store aisle. (5) Multiple tiers of shelves are shown, packed with gold and white Maneki-neko figurines. (6) A close-up reveals a textile pouch featuring embroidered pink, black, and red beckoning cats against a blue wave-patterned background. (7) Transparent glass cat-shaped jars and illustrated Daruma cards are displayed on shelves. (8) A woman in a white puffer jacket walks away from the camera through a store aisle toward more product displays. (9) Red tote bags featuring Japanese motifs like Daruma and Maneki-neko are hanging on a rack. (10) The video concludes with a stylized pink logo for "japanuts.com" featuring social media icons.
